scope: Synthetic prototype procedures; not execution evidence

cases.title: Server permissions and information isolation
cases.preconditions: Coordinator, technician, Finance and Systems test identities; two company/site scopes.
cases.steps: Read an assigned site as technician; request another site directly; request Finance data, search suggestions, document preview/export and notification payloads; repeat as Systems without business grants.
cases.expected: Assigned context succeeds; unauthorised APIs/files/exports/search/notifications reveal no restricted fields or record titles. Systems cannot approve service or Finance by default.
cases.evidence: API responses, role-grant fixture and negative access assertions.

cases.title: Same-name account mapping
cases.preconditions: Two SYN companies each contain a customer called SYN Greenhouse Demonstration with distinct external IDs.
cases.steps: Create work against site Q01; propose the other-company debtor; submit a handoff without verified mapping; then choose the correct explicit mapping.
cases.expected: Ambiguous/wrong-company mapping cannot authorise financial release; correct connection/company/customer tuple is retained in source snapshot and every target mapping.
cases.evidence: Mapping records, refusal code VAL-01 and accepted tuple.

cases.title: Unknown equipment identity
cases.preconditions: Asset SYN-A02 has no verified serial; another asset has a similar description.
cases.steps: Attempt asset-specific scope authorisation; add an identification plan with reviewer/method/limits; authorise bounded identification work; later verify the asset.
cases.expected: First attempt blocks with VAL-02. Approved identification plan permits only its scope. Serial is never guessed; later verification preserves original visit-time uncertainty.
cases.evidence: Before/after scope versions, identification plan and audit.

cases.title: Incomplete intake and readiness refusal
cases.preconditions: Ticket missing access/control evidence; urgent priority; policy marks mandatory site control as non-waivable.
cases.steps: Save incomplete ticket; attempt authorisation/dispatch; try a generic override; supply reviewed required context and permitted preparation evidence.
cases.expected: Draft is saved with owner. Missing stage fields are listed. Urgent flag or general override cannot waive the mandatory control. Only valid evidence permits progression.
cases.evidence: Field-level errors, readiness assessments and policy version.

cases.title: Scope and coverage authority
cases.preconditions: Inspection-only approved scope; disputed coverage; technician proposes a shutdown/extra task.
cases.steps: Record the extra-work request; try to change approved scope in place; create a reviewed successor with explicit permitted conditions; inspect financial treatment.
cases.expected: Original scope remains exact. Technician cannot approve extra work. Coverage dispute remains separate from billing/supplier recovery; no automatic free work or invoice.
cases.evidence: Scope hashes, approval event, rejected command and unresolved Finance decision.

cases.title: Complete pack issue and crew acknowledgement
cases.preconditions: Confirmed two-person appointment; checked nine-section pack and exact technical sources.
cases.steps: Request issue; pause renderer; complete durable storage; acknowledge as first technician; try start; acknowledge as second; re-evaluate readiness and start.
cases.expected: Queued generation is not Issued. Exactly one durable issue is created. First acknowledgement does not cover the second recipient; start blocks until all required conditions pass.
cases.evidence: Output/manifest hashes, recipient events and start guard result.

cases.title: Material pack amendment
cases.preconditions: Pack revision 1 issued/acknowledged; scope/control amendment required before attendance.
cases.steps: Raise material amendment; inspect dispatch; prepare/check/issue revision 2; retry old acknowledgement; acknowledge revision 2 as each required recipient.
cases.expected: Dispatch hold begins when material change is raised. Original issue remains recoverable. Revision 1 acknowledgement cannot satisfy revision 2; each affected recipient must respond.
cases.evidence: Old/new output hashes, change reason, hold and acknowledgement list.

cases.title: Concurrent edit of one appointment
cases.preconditions: Two independent sessions read appointment version 3.
cases.steps: Session A moves the booking and commits version 4. Session B submits a different move expecting version 3. Inspect booking, reservations and both user proposals.
cases.expected: A single version-4 outcome persists. B receives VAL-05 and retains proposed input; no silent overwrite or partial resource release occurs.
cases.evidence: Two request/response traces, reservation rows, audit and retained form state.

cases.title: Concurrent crew conflict across bookings
cases.preconditions: Two different proposed appointments both need SYN-T01 during 09:00–11:00; each also includes a different second technician.
cases.steps: Confirm both concurrently. Inspect all resource reservations. Attempt an adjacent visit whose explicit travel buffer overlaps the winning booking.
cases.expected: Exactly one conflicting booking confirms; no partial crew reservation from loser. Adjacent core times still fail if buffer overlaps. No serial UI-only check can bypass database guard.
cases.evidence: Concurrent database/API test, complete crew reservation sets and VAL-06.

cases.title: Project-request boundary and keyboard move
cases.preconditions: Confirmed appointment linked to a synthetic project reference.
cases.steps: Submit a project-date change request. Inspect original booking; dispatcher uses keyboard Move action to evaluate/reject then later accept a valid request.
cases.expected: Project request does not overwrite confirmed attendance. Rejection has reason. Accepted move applies the same guards as drag/drop, records history and requires pack/contact review.
cases.evidence: Change-request state, before/after booking, keyboard recording and contact tasks.

cases.title: Offline save, restart and quota failure
cases.preconditions: Two assigned cached jobs, current pack revisions; service worker enabled in a persistent test browser profile.
cases.steps: Disconnect; capture note/time/photo; close and reopen browser with same profile; inspect saved entries. Force a storage/quota write failure on another entry.
cases.expected: Committed local entries survive tested restart and show last sync/revision. Failed write never shows Saved. Evidence remains distinguishable from server-synchronised/reviewed work.
cases.evidence: IndexedDB state, restart evidence, quota failure message and device/browser version.

cases.title: Duplicate replay and payload conflict
cases.preconditions: 100 saved operations with stable IDs and one dependent attachment; server receipts initially absent.
cases.steps: Synchronise; lose client acknowledgement; replay all 100; reuse one ID with changed payload; interrupt and retry photo finalisation.
cases.expected: Exactly 100 evidence records exist; original receipts replay. Changed payload gets VAL-12. One final attachment identity exists; completion waits for its Available receipt.
cases.evidence: Record counts, operation receipts, hashes and dependency queue state.

cases.title: Time/material correction and review
cases.preconditions: 90-minute labour interval and 2 EA consumed material; entries initially Draft.
cases.steps: Submit and approve entries; try in-place edit; create reasoned successor correction; inspect dependent report and handoff readiness.
cases.expected: Captured, reviewed and financial quantities remain separate. Approved original cannot change. Successor retains lineage; affected downstream review is invalidated without rewriting processed history.
cases.evidence: Entry revisions, guard response, dependent-review state and audit.

cases.title: Partial work and return visit
cases.preconditions: One work order addresses two tasks/assets; first visit cannot finish the second task.
cases.steps: Submit Complete attendance with Partial scope outcome and owned follow-up; reviewer accepts attendance; propose return appointment; attempt whole-ticket/order closure prematurely.
cases.expected: Visit can become Completed while order remains InProgress and ticket Waiting/Active. Remaining task and owner visible to return crew. Premature closure is blocked.
cases.evidence: Independent state records, follow-up, return appointment and closure refusal.

cases.title: Customer response alternatives
cases.preconditions: Exact issued customer report; five independent response fixtures.
cases.steps: Capture Accepted, AcceptedWithReservations, Declined, Unavailable and Disputed outcomes against presented content; omit mandatory remarks once.
cases.expected: Each response retains exact revision/hash/context. Reservations/decline/dispute need detail; unavailable has reason/contact action without invented signer. No response automatically approves billing.
cases.evidence: Response records, validation, owned activities and unchanged Finance state.

cases.title: Signed report revision
cases.preconditions: Report revision 1 issued and accepted; a finding needs material correction.
cases.steps: Create revision 2, re-review and issue; inspect old/new PDFs and response status; try attaching the old response to revision 2.
cases.expected: Revision 1 and its response remain exact. Revision 2 has new content/hash and no inherited signature/acceptance. VAL-20 prevents false reassociation.
cases.evidence: Two manifests/outputs, response foreign keys and rejected operation.

cases.title: Finance split, allocation and no-posting outcome
cases.preconditions: F-06: 90 approved MIN split 60 Billable/30 NonBillable; 2 EA part; verified synthetic mapping.
cases.steps: Submit/review one handoff; concurrently allocate the same source quantity elsewhere; process synthetic target for approved billable treatment; reconcile non-billable disposition separately.
cases.expected: Over-allocation is rejected atomically. All 90 MIN remain dispositioned. Target 60 MIN does not imply missing 30 when reviewed no-posting evidence covers it. No real ERP result is claimed.
cases.evidence: Allocation sum, target line map, non-billable reason, reconciliation record and synthetic label.

cases.title: Exact document access and source movement
cases.preconditions: Issued synthetic pack/report/Finance output; source adapter supports simulated rename/move/version removal; restricted internal notes.
cases.steps: Rename source; resolve by stable identity; simulate identity-changing move and missing version; open retained exact issue; attempt technician/customer access to Finance/internal output.
cases.expected: Supported reference resolves or creates a specific exception. Historical issued bytes remain exact. No silent latest-version substitution or restricted content leak, including metadata/attachment names.
cases.evidence: Reference resolution, output hashes, manifest and negative access/content assertions.

cases.title: Unknown external outcome and processing concurrency
cases.preconditions: Approved handoff; simulator creates one target then times out. Two Finance sessions can claim processing.
cases.steps: Race processing claims; allow one simulator effect; timeout; attempt repeat; perform outcome lookup; map discovered target and reconcile.
cases.expected: One processor claim and target effect only. State becomes OutcomeUnknown. Blind retry/cancel blocked; lookup resolves original reference before reconciliation.
cases.evidence: Claim/version evidence, simulator effect count, lookup and final mapping.

cases.title: Account amounts, unapplied cash and reversal
cases.preconditions: F-01 original 1100, applied payment 400, credit 100, remaining 600; F-02 unapplied 200; F-03 payment reversal.
cases.steps: Render F-01/F-02; compare source fields; apply F-03 observation; inspect history and company/currency labels.
cases.expected: Original remains 1100; open 600; unapplied 200 separate. After reversal current remaining is 1000 with lineage. Page subtotal and cash are not silently netted into invoice balance.
cases.evidence: Exact expected/observed decimal values, source timestamps and status history.

cases.title: Incomplete source and undefined metric
cases.preconditions: F-04 missing second page; F-05 unknown commitment definition; existing last-good account snapshot.
cases.steps: Fail a refresh midway; filter to one page; request undefined metric.
cases.expected: Incomplete/unavailable/undefined states are explicit. Last-good values show their as-at/failure context. No verified zero, whole-account total from page sum, or invented commitment formula.
cases.evidence: Import run completeness, UI/JSON states and metric definition reference.

cases.title: Restore and safe queue recovery
cases.preconditions: Synthetic database, issued objects, audit/outbox and an OutcomeUnknown handoff.
cases.steps: Take documented backup/checkpoint; restore into clean isolated environment with outbound effects disabled; compare records/files; recover queue leases and investigate unknown item before enabling simulation.
cases.expected: Referenced objects and record relationships restore; hashes/counts match declared backup point. Outbox replay does not duplicate issues/targets. Actual measured recovery/loss recorded, not claimed candidate SLA.
cases.evidence: Restore commands, timestamps, counts/hashes, queue receipts and measured results.

cases.title: Template change, long output and storage failure
cases.preconditions: Long customer/site names, many assets/findings/pages; template versions 1/2; injectable storage/finalisation failure.
cases.steps: Generate selected OUT outputs; inspect all pages; change template/source during generation; fail file store then database finalisation; retry same operation.
cases.expected: No clipped/overlapping or confidential content. Stale render cannot issue without review. Durable storage failure does not show Issued; retry reconciles one output/issue. Prior template output unchanged.
cases.evidence: Page review checklist, output hashes, failed-attempt states and issue counts.

cases.title: Offline reassignment, cancellation and revocation
cases.preconditions: Technician offline with revision 1 and unsent evidence; server reassigns/cancels and issues changed scope.
cases.steps: Capture locally; reconnect with active identity but stale assignment; repeat with revoked normal access and no recovery capability; then exercise separately authorised recovery capability.
cases.expected: Stale evidence retained in restricted ReviewRequired and excluded from approved totals. Revoked user gets no normal access; local evidence retained until authorised recovery. Old pack never claimed current; direct-contact need visible.
cases.evidence: Access/assignment versions, local queue, restricted recovery receipts and audit.

cases.title: Effective site/operator and asset history
cases.preconditions: Completed visit and issued report under old operator/site/configuration; future appointment exists.
cases.steps: Record reviewed operator change/asset move at an effective instant; inspect current context, historic report and future pack readiness.
cases.expected: Current records reflect effective change; historical report/context unchanged. Affected future work requires review; no duplicate identity or retroactive reassignment. Automatic recurrence remains explicitly deferred.
cases.evidence: Effective relationships, old/new snapshots and future review task.

cases.title: Cancellation and actual-work preservation
cases.preconditions: One future confirmed visit with issued pack; another visit contains actual field labour.
cases.steps: Cancel future visit with reason; attempt cancellation of visit with actual work; inspect resource reservations, packs, contacts and captured entries.
cases.expected: Future reservations released and history retained; contact tasks created. Actual-work visit cannot be erased/cancelled as unstarted; completion with remaining-work disposition is required.
cases.evidence: Reservation changes, VAL-21, retained entries and cancellation audit.

cases.title: Accessibility and defined load
cases.preconditions: BP-02 benchmark fixture and recorded browser/device/network/build; keyboard and representative screen-reader setup.
cases.steps: Complete intake, booking move, field submission, report response and Finance review by keyboard; inspect errors/focus/reflow; run core-read timing sample including cold/warm distinction.
cases.expected: Workflow has labelled controls, meaningful focus, no drag-only action or colour-only meaning. Record p95 against candidate 3-second target with actual profile; disclose failures and no unsupported whole-product conformance claim.
cases.evidence: Accessibility findings, timings/raw sample, environment and remediation evidence.

cases.title: Schema, policy and application update
cases.preconditions: Queued payload v1, application update and policy/template successor; backup/recovery instructions.
cases.steps: Deploy compatible update; replay old payload; try unsupported schema; publish changed scheduling rule; inspect existing issued content and future bookings.
cases.expected: Supported payload migrates/accepts once. Unsupported original retained for recovery. Future affected work flagged; no silent reassignment/reissue or changed historic evidence. Software rollback does not erase external outcomes.
cases.evidence: Migration/result receipts, preserved payload, impact tasks and release note.

cases.title: Honest empty, error and partial states
cases.preconditions: Known records plus injectable query/permission/render/upload failures.
cases.steps: Visit all 15 screens in empty, populated, loading, failed and applicable restricted/stale states; retry save while retaining input.
cases.expected: No-records differs from could-not-load. Errors provide actionable recovery without stack traces/secrets. Failed saves retain safe input; unsupported features never appear successful.
cases.evidence: Screen-state checklist, representative captures and API outcomes.

cases.title: Complete owner demonstration
cases.preconditions: Fresh deterministic synthetic seed; completed P01–P12; previous PT findings dispositioned.
cases.steps: Execute the full scope narrative from customer history through return visit, report reservation and Finance reconciliation; restart application/database during a safe saved stage; revisit next technician history.
cases.expected: A complete persisted journey demonstrates preparation, controlled scheduling, useful history, field evidence and Finance outcome. All remaining limitations are labelled; no live integration/customer message claimed.
cases.evidence: Commit/environment, walkthrough record, outputs, test results and open-defect list.
